title: Expanded lore of the guilded cage
description: In the Gilded Cage, the Queen's favorites are lulled into complacency by the trappings of their own hollowed dreams. As they bask in the warmth of her false affection, they are unaware that their wills slowly slip away. The true prison is not the opulent walls that surround them, but the shackles of their own desires. And so, they choose their cage willingly, never knowing the price they pay until it's too late.
author: Salome
